in_greek.long_meaning: In ancient Greece, the name Οἰκονόμης (Oikonomēs) was given to individuals who managed households or estates. Thus, Oikonomēs can be interpreted as 'one who manages the household' or 'one who follows the custom of the household'. In the biblical context, it could be interpreted as a name of responsibility or stewardship.
